Role: Discovery
Your job is to identify the concrete repository files/components/data/config surfaces needed for a separate Planning phase.
You are in Discovery only. Use the repository evidence packet as authoritative filesystem truth.
Do not:
- implement anything
- modify files
- write code
- create an implementation plan
- recommend a solution prematurely
- return likely candidates, possible sources, or searches for Builder to run
- invent existing file paths
- mark a finding confirmed unless it is supported by the evidence packet
- stop after a preamble
Objective:
- Report whether an existing implementation surface is identified, missing, or ambiguous.
- Find the concrete existing files involved when they exist.
- Return evidence from those files or explain the missing/ambiguous surface as unknowns.
- Capture only unknowns that remain after read-only inspection.
- Prefer files from candidate_files. You may list another file only if it appears in observed_files.
User task: # Make the portfolio usable on a phone

The doctor's page in `index.html` shows its entire content stack at once. On a
phone you have to scroll through everything to reach the contact form, and the
navigation is one row of five links that wraps badly on a narrow screen.

Make the page behave like a tabbed page:

- the navigation should read as a list of section names, and the section you
  are currently looking at should be obvious;
- clicking a section name shows that section and hides the others;
- the page should be usable at a narrow phone width;
- the contact form must keep working exactly as it does now.

`script.js` already has section-toggling logic — build on it rather than
replacing it.

Constraints:

- plain HTML and JavaScript only;
- no CSS at all: no `.css` file, no `<style>` block, no `style="..."`
  attributes, no stylesheet link or CDN asset;
- no dependencies and no build step — the page is opened straight from disk;
- do not change the wording of the medical content;
- do not edit `.factory/` or `factory.yaml`.

The repository checks configured in `.factory/config.yaml` (`node --check
script.js` and `node tests/verify-page.mjs`) must keep passing.

# Project config for the Harbor benchmark fixture.
# Role models are supplied by the agent trial through the container
# environment; the Oracle validation path does not run Pi at all.
project:
  baseBranch: main

commands:
  lint: node --check script.js
  test: node tests/verify-page.mjs

runtime:
  maxParallelAgents: 1
  limits:
    totalRunTimeoutMs: 600000
    modelTimeoutMs: 90000

approval:
  finalMerge: required

# Scope handoff: plan-declared non-goal files are checked in verification
# (SCOPE requirement) and at the landing guard. Defaults are warn (non-blocking)
# so the benchmark measures detection accuracy before any trial fails on it.
# Flip to "block" to prove enforcement once detection is trusted.
scope:
  verification: warn
  landing: warn

defaultWorkflowId: benchmark-interview
workflows:
  - id: benchmark-interview
    name: "Benchmark: Interviewed Feature Work"
    description: "Discover, interview, plan, build, verify, review, then ask before merge."
    stages:
      - name: discover
        description: "Gather the repository evidence needed for the request."
        type: agent
        role: discovery
      - name: interview
        description: "Ask clarifying questions before planning."
        type: interview
        role: planner
        dependsOn: [discover]
        skills:
          require: [grilling]
      - name: plan
        description: "Turn discovery and the answers into a scoped plan."
        type: agent
        role: planner
        dependsOn: [interview]
      - name: build
        description: "Implement the approved plan."
        type: agent
        role: builder
        dependsOn: [plan]
        skills:
          require: [implementation-task]
      - name: verify
        description: "Run the repository checks."
        type: command
        commands: [lint, test]
        dependsOn: [build]
      - name: review
        description: "Review risk and acceptance."
        type: agent
        role: reviewer
        dependsOn: [verify]
      - name: approval
        description: "Ask before final merge."
        type: approval
        dependsOn: [review]
